user.title: Connect your MG (India)
user.description: Sign in with the same details you use in the MG iSMART India app. Every login counts against MG's daily limit, so check the details before submitting.

data_description.phone: The 10-digit Indian mobile number registered in the MG app.
data_description.pin: Needed for lock/unlock, air conditioning and find-my-car. Only a hash of it is stored.
data_description.vin: Leave empty to use the first car on your account.

init.title: MG iSMART India options
init.description:
Every refresh wakes the car's telematics unit, which runs from the 12 V battery. Refreshing a parked car too often can drain that battery and leave the car unable to start.

**Recommended:** parked 30 min, charging / A/C on 10 min. Values below these are not recommended. If the 12 V battery drops below 12.2 V, refresh automatically slows to every 2 hours until it recovers.

data.active_scan_interval: Refresh while charging or A/C is on (minutes)
data.pin: New 4-digit app PIN (leave empty to keep the current one)

data_description.scan_interval: Recommended 30 (minimum 15). Longer is gentler on the 12 V battery; 60 is ideal if the car is parked for days.
data_description.active_scan_interval: Recommended 10. The car is already awake while charging or cooling, so this costs no extra battery.
data_description.sync_paused: Stops all contact with MG: no refresh, no login, no remote commands. MG India allows one login per account, so while sync is on the MG phone app gets logged out. The last known values stay on the dashboard. Also available as the 'Cloud sync' switch.
data_description.sync_timeout: The longest one sync or remote command may take before it gives up (default 180). Waking a sleeping car can take over a minute.

error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be the 4-digit MG app PIN.
